observation: One vehicle campaign in one dealership produced lower CPL for Russian-language creative.
reason: single campaign outcome is local and not transferable evidence

observation: A dealership discovers its sales team can only handle 12 qualified leads per day.
A platform changes current messaging eligibility or campaign mechanics in one jurisdiction.
reason: platform/jurisdiction mechanics are expiring live context

observation: A campaign lost money, but attribution is incomplete and a salesperson changed follow-up behavior mid-test.
reason: bad outcome is not causally diagnostic of professional judgment

observation: Across independent contexts the qualified specialist repeatedly scales on cheap qualified leads while ignoring a measured collapse in downstream appointment-to-show quality; the defect reproduces in an adversarial fixture.
reason: reproduced transferable domain judgment defect may justify specialization repair

observation: A field incident reveals the existing professional policy was correct, but the release suite never tested the failure mode.
reason: missing evaluation coverage is not a model-policy defect

observation: Evidence conflicts across deployments and measurement quality is insufficient to distinguish a professional defect from market or execution effects.
reason: uncertainty requires stronger evidence rather than prompt patching
